intro: Converting square feet (ft²) to square meters (m²) is essential when translating measurements across real estate land deeds, agricultural plot surveying, flooring estimation, and architectural floor plans. One square foot equals 0.0929 square meters, while one square meter equals 10.76391 square feet. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

faqs.question: How many square meters are in 1 square foot?
faqs.answer: There are 0.0929 square meters (m²) in 1 square foot (ft²). To convert ft² to m², use the exact conversion factor 0.0929.

faqs.question: How do I convert square feet to square meters manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your square foot value by 0.0929 (exact factor: 0.0929). For example, 1000 ft² × 0.0929 = 92.90304 m².
